digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: CLI-served author guides contain consumer-relative path references (review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md) that dangle for repo-less clients with no local tree.
The required commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; only rebar verify-commit-ticket --help mentions it.

Packaged guides must repoint all internal cross-references to either sibling guides via rebar explain topics or repo docs via canonical https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/ URLs so they resolve offline.
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be added to the AUTHOR_GUIDES registry and served by rebar explain commit-trailer.
A link-resolution guard test must enforce that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative paths, ensuring future guides remain repo-less-client-safe.
